versions.name: RXV2-0.9.478-configurator-note
versions.notes: Selector cards and help now say where to find them in the configurator: Adjustments rows 31 (Bank) and 37 (Rates) - scroll a long way down.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.477-bar-scale-fix
versions.notes: Transmitter channels: the selector bars draw again (a missing scale constant crashed the Bank row and hid the Rates row).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.476-one-adjustment
versions.notes: Selectors rebuilt on Rotorflight's own model: ONE adjustment per selector, equal sections between two draggable END points, with a positions count (2-6). Why: each Rotorflight adjustment remembers its last value and only fires when that changes, so per-section adjustments jam on re-entry (the 'stuck on profile 4'). Re-save once; drag the ends to your switch's lowest and highest positions.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.475-aux-off-by-one
versions.notes: IMPORTANT: switch channels were written ONE channel high to the flight controller. Rotorflight has five control channels (collective included), so its AUX1 is channel 6 - the pages used the channel-5 convention, so Arm, Rescue, added functions AND the bank/rates selectors all landed one channel above where you chose. Fixed on Switches and Transmitter channels. RE-SAVE on Transmitter channels once, then confirm with the live marker.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.474-selectors-verified
versions.notes: Selector maths verified against Rotorflight's own formula for even, quarter, uneven and two-section layouts (zero mismatches over the whole switch travel); sections near the top of travel use a mirrored window so nothing is lost at 2125. Re-save the selectors once.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.473-selectors-bite
versions.notes: Bank/Rates selectors now actually switch profiles: Rotorflight silently ignores a mapped adjustment whose min equals max, so each section is now written as N..N+1 with its mapping window centred on the section - the whole section lands on N. Re-save the selectors (Switches or Transmitter channels page) and flip the switch.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.472-edit-selectors
versions.notes: Switches page: the Bank & Rates selectors are editable in place - channel picker, draggable section junctions, Save writes them to the flight controller (one truth shared with Transmitter channels).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.471-selectors-local
versions.notes: Switches page shows the Bank & Rates bars from this phone's choices even before a Save (marked as such), and the heading no longer runs together. Transmitter channels remembers its defaults.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.470-one-button-cal
versions.notes: ESC throttle calibration is now ONE big button whose words change with the stage (Start - PLUG THE BATTERY, wait for beeps, tap - WAIT FOR CONFIRMATION BEEPS, tap - CALIBRATED, unplug). No abort button: unplugging the battery is the abort, and the throttle hold lapses by itself.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.469-selectors-visible
versions.notes: Switches page: the Bank & Rates selectors card is always present - it says 'not set up yet' with a link to Transmitter channels until a Save has recorded them, then shows the bars and the flight controller's live answer.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.468-plug-battery
versions.notes: ESC calibration (proven on a Tribunus!): the 'NOW PLUG THE FLIGHT BATTERY' instruction is a big orange banner - the one thing you must not miss.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.467-esc-calibration
versions.notes: ESC throttle calibration FROM THE PHONE (Malcolm's ask): the ESC page holds the motor channel at full throttle (renewed every half second, lapses by itself a second after the phone stops), you plug the battery, the ESC beeps, tap to drop to minimum, beeps again, done - the configurator's Motors-tab procedure without the computer. Guards: transmitter must be off, model disarmed, blades-off confirmation.
